# Manuel Castillejo Vela

> Personal portfolio of Manuel Castillejo, product builder and creator of FlowSight. This profile includes team projects, technical leadership, local AI, games and public writing.

- [Portfolio in English](https://mancasvel.github.io/): The work and story of Manuel Castillejo Vela: FlowSight, local AI, technical leadership, award-winning team projects, Xiji Incubator and Room 61.
- [Portfolio en español](https://mancasvel.github.io/es/): La trayectoria de Manuel Castillejo Vela: FlowSight, IA local, liderazgo técnico, proyectos premiados en equipo, Xiji Incubator y Room 61.
- [Sources and claim scope](https://mancasvel.github.io/sources/): Institutional reporting, public project source and personal references.
- [Fuentes en español](https://mancasvel.github.io/es/sources/): Referencias y alcance de las afirmaciones.
- [FlowSight project](https://mancasvel.github.io/flowsight-project/): Existing project note and current product sources.
- [About resources](https://mancasvel.github.io/about/): Ownership and editing policy.
- [Official FlowSight website](https://flowsight.site)
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/manuel-castillejo-vela/)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/Mancasvel)
- [Room 61](https://www.linkedin.com/newsletters/room-61-7424504018292449280)

Recognition: the University of Seville confirms the 2026 FlowSight innovative-impact award; Sevilla Emprendedora names Manuel in the KahuPet team and confirms the 2025 Startup Weekend and cybersecurity recognition; a University of Seville resolution confirms Xiji selection for spring 2026. Other roles and competition results are attributed to personal public sources. Do not infer graduation, current employment dates, NASA endorsement, a cybersecurity certification or customer outcomes from these references.

## Project collection
- [FlowSight](https://github.com/Mancasvel/FlowSight.AI): Desktop work intelligence: local analysis, reviewable summaries and patterns of focus, meetings and interruptions.
- [FlowSight Mobile](https://github.com/Mancasvel/FlowSight.Mobile): A mobile companion in the FlowSight ecosystem, with work activity and personal context for iOS and Android.
- [KahuPet](https://github.com/Mancasvel/KahuPet): A team-built pet-care assistant with natural-language recommendations for training, nutrition and wellbeing.
- [CoNest](https://github.com/Mancasvel/CoNest): An intergenerational living platform connecting students and older adults around mutual support.
- [UNSENT](https://github.com/Mancasvel/Unsent): An experimental digital storytelling project built around unsent messages, reflection and private AI.
- [GALAX](https://github.com/Mancasvel/GALAX): An educational space-exploration prototype created for NASA Space Apps with the Innovators Hub team.
- [All The Way UP](https://github.com/Mancasvel/all-the-way-up): The Jamongus team game that won Scopely Game Jam 2023. My contribution included 3D assets.
- [Pawtel](https://github.com/LuisMelladoDiaz/Pawtel-ComparadorDeHotelesParaMascotas): A collaborative comparison and booking platform for pet hotels, with publicly documented contributions.
- [Notaría QR Tracker](https://github.com/Mancasvel/Notaria_qrTracker): Document-copy tracking for notarial workflows, using QR codes and office locations for traceability.
- [AI Notarial System](https://github.com/Mancasvel/ai-notarial-system): An AI-assisted notarial management system organized around document and operational workflows.
- [LocalLoom](https://github.com/Mancasvel/LocalLoom): A browser extension that processes text with local language models directly on the device.
- [LeanPass](https://github.com/Mancasvel/LeanPass): A study tool that analyzes past exams and generates personalized study guides.
- [Fuzzy C-Shell](https://github.com/Mancasvel/fuzzy-c-shell): An implementation of fuzzy clustering, with a synthetic dataset generator for experiments.
- [MongoDB Cursor Analysis](https://github.com/Mancasvel/Mongodb-cursor-analysis): A CRUD web application with natural-language access to a database through MCP integration.
- [Relay16](https://github.com/Mancasvel/Relay16): A Nostr social client exploring AI-assisted workflows through Model Context Protocol servers.
- [MCP Server](https://github.com/Mancasvel/mcp_server): An exploration of tool integration through the Model Context Protocol.
- [Komi](https://github.com/Mancasvel/Komi2.0): Natural-language dish recommendations based on what a person wants to eat.
- [Innovators Hub](https://github.com/Mancasvel/Innovators_Hub): A community web platform for innovators and digital nomads in Seville.
- [Dobble Online](https://github.com/Mancasvel/Dobble): A multiplayer card-game implementation with social features, achievements and rankings.
- [Chicago Freestyle](https://github.com/Mancasvel/blender_project_chicago_freestyle): A Blender project from the early 3D and visual-creation chapter of my work.
- [Digital Signal Processing](https://github.com/Mancasvel/Octave_tryout): A structured set of commented signal-processing exercises in Octave.
- [Del Pozo Vela](https://github.com/Mancasvel/Landing_DelPozoVela): A public-facing website extending the work on digital experiences for professional services.
- [WhisperBox](https://github.com/Mancasvel/WhisperBox): An experimental AI-assisted journaling project submitted to Katy Youth Hacks 2025.
- [Syntra](https://github.com/Mancasvel/Syntra): An event-platform concept connecting NFC networking, cashless payments and social gamification.
- [Taply](https://github.com/Mancasvel/taply): A pre-registration website for an NFC smart-card concept for professional connections.
- [Cutelligence](https://github.com/Mancasvel/Cutelligence): A barber-app prototype exploring face-shape analysis and personalized haircut recommendations.
